title: Defense Test Range Blast Overpressure and Hearing Conservation Record
description: Evidence model for weapons test-range blast-overpressure peak-pressure monitoring, exclusion-zone verification, and hearing-conservation PPE checks during live-fire and static detonation testing. Captures the test-operational phase distinct from manufacture-phase propellant mixing, cryogenic fueling, magazine storage, and final-assembly solvent work.

peak_overpressure_psi.description: Peak blast overpressure (psi) measured at the operator/pit-crew station.

exclusion_zone_clear.description: True if the Q-D exclusion zone was verified clear of unauthorized personnel before the test event.

hearing_protection_verified.description: True if dual hearing protection (plugs + muffs) was verified worn by all exposed personnel.
